title: Pool Day
subtitle: Henry keeps Leo on the dry side of the pool.

levels.title: Leo Spots the Pool
levels.clue: Mom wants everyone outside by the pool. Leo grabbed Henry's ring and froze.

levels.title: First Little Splash
levels.clue: Splashes creep from the pool. Match on or beside them before they reach Leo's towel.

levels.title: The Dry Way
levels.clue: Henry shows Leo the dry stones along the edge of the patio.

levels.title: Cannonball Next Door
levels.clue: A neighbor's cannonball sends drops flying. Henry stays between Leo and the water.

levels.title: Wet Paws, Brave Paws
levels.clue: The splashes come a little faster. Henry nudges back any that get too close.

levels.title: Sunny Towel Nap
levels.clue: Leo dozed off on the warm towel. Henry gives gentle woofs to wake him.

levels.title: Pool Toy Parade
levels.clue: Pool toys bob by and splash the deck. Keep Leo's towel dry.

levels.title: Between Leo and the Water
levels.clue: Henry walks on the pool side so Leo can walk on the dry side.

levels.title: The Big Splash
levels.clue: Mom dives in! Clear the big wave of splashes before it reaches Leo.

levels.title: Dry and Proud
levels.clue: One last splash wave, then Leo hands Henry's ring back beside Mom's chair.
